resources.string: A native Android shell for future field-ready workflows.
This standalone Android Studio project is intentionally isolated from the Django app so mobile features can be designed, built, and tested independently.
Placeholder actions will be connected as the native workflow expands.
Material 3 surfaces, branded cards, and placeholder flows for the next native client iteration.
Gradle files, resources, and app sources live entirely under the android folder to protect the existing Python/Django setup.
